about.heading: English made for Japanese speakers.
about.subtext: Hello Donguri is a friendlier way to learn everyday English — a few words at a time, with a cast of characters to keep you company.
about.value_everyday_body: Everyday words and phrases, practised in real conversations.
about.value_friendly_body: Mistakes are part of learning. Donguri and friends cheer you on.
about.value_short_body: Short lessons and reviews that fit around your day.
about.why_body: Most English courses are made for learners everywhere. We start from Japanese instead: every word has a picture, audio and a Japanese meaning, and grammar is explained the way you'd explain it to a friend.
about.why_heading: Learning a language should feel like making friends.

home.decks.body: From your very first hello to business meetings, choose the decks that fit you — and switch any time.
home.decks.d_be_verb: Your first sentences: I am, you are, it is.
home.decks.d_business: Run meetings, give updates and make your point.
home.decks.d_conditionals: Talk about what might have been.
home.decks.d_food: Order, cook and talk about what you eat.
home.decks.d_greetings: Hello, goodbye, thank you — the words you'll use every day.
home.decks.d_health: Describe how you feel, at the doctor's and beyond.
home.decks.d_idioms: Sound natural with the phrases native speakers use.
home.decks.d_nuance: Soften, stress and hedge — say exactly what you mean.
home.decks.d_opinions: Agree, disagree and explain why — politely.
home.decks.d_past: Tell stories about what happened yesterday and last year.
home.decks.d_sport: Talk about what you play, watch and love doing.
home.decks.d_travel: Tickets, directions and getting around a new city.
home.decks.heading: Pick a topic. Pick your level.
home.faq.beginners_a: Yes. Decks start with everyday words and simple grammar, and every word comes with a picture, audio and a Japanese meaning, so you never have to guess.
home.faq.beginners_q: I'm a complete beginner. Is this for me?
home.faq.cancel_a: From the billing page in your account, at any time. You keep access until the end of the period you've paid for.
home.faq.choose_a: Yes. Browse the decks and add the ones you want to your word list. New words come from the decks you've added, and you can skip words you already know.
home.faq.choose_q: Can I choose what to learn?
home.faq.device_a: No download needed. Hello Donguri runs in the browser on your phone, tablet or computer, and your progress is saved to your account.
home.faq.device_q: Is there an app to download?
home.faq.free_a: Learn your first 9 words straight away, with no sign-up. Make a free account to save your progress and learn up to 40 words and 20 grammar points, with reviews included. After that, a membership unlocks everything, and you can cancel anytime.
home.faq.free_q: What can I do for free?
home.faq.heading: Good to know before you start.
home.faq.reviews_a: Nothing is lost. Due reviews wait for you on your dashboard. Your streak resets, but your words, XP and level stay.
home.faq.reviews_q: What happens if I miss a day?
home.faq.time_a: A few minutes is enough. Three new words, a short quiz and whatever reviews are due usually take five to ten minutes. You can always do more.
home.faq.time_q: How much time does it take each day?
home.final.heading: Your first three words are five minutes away.
home.final.microcopy_free: 40 words and 20 grammar points free with an account.
home.final.subtext_free: Try your first words right now, no sign-up needed. Donguri will have your first lesson ready.
home.hero.headline: English That Grows With You
home.hero.subtext: Build your English with short lessons, timed reviews and friendly conversation practice
home.how.challenge_body: The daily challenge asks you to use what you've learnt in a friendly chat with Charles Duck.
home.how.challenge_title: Use it in a real chat
home.how.heading: A short routine you can keep every day.
home.how.learn_body: Each one gets a picture, audio, a Japanese meaning and real example sentences.
home.how.quiz_body: A quick quiz checks you can recognise each word, then type it yourself.
home.how.review_body: Words come back after hours, then days, then weeks, until you know them for good.
home.how.subtext: Four steps, a few minutes each. Your dashboard always shows what's next.
home.japanese.feedback_body: Daily challenge tips come in simple Japanese as well as English.
home.japanese.heading: Everything explained in the language you think in.
home.japanese.login_body: Or use your email. No new password needed.
home.japanese.login_title: Sign in with LINE or Google
home.japanese.phone_body: It runs in your browser, with nothing to install, and your progress follows you.
home.japanese.ui_body: Switch between Japanese and English at any time. Meanings and example translations are always in Japanese.
home.lessons.audio_body: Play the word and every example sentence out loud.
home.lessons.examples_body: The word is highlighted in each one, with a natural Japanese translation underneath.
home.lessons.forms_body: go, goes, went, gone, going — laid out side by side.
home.lessons.grammar_body: Patterns are drawn as building blocks, showing which parts you say and which you fill in.
home.lessons.heading: Lessons that explain, not just list.
home.lessons.japanese_body: Short explanations in Japanese whenever a word or pattern needs one.
home.lessons.picture_body: So you link the English to the thing itself, not just a translation.
home.lessons.subtext: Vocabulary and grammar are taught in the same short sessions, so you learn a word and how to use it together.
home.practice.fair_body: Capital letters and extra spaces don't count against you, and any accepted answer is fine.
home.practice.heading: Recall it yourself, and it stays with you.
home.practice.lesson_body: Got one wrong? Open the word's lesson right from the question to see why.
home.practice.lesson_title: The lesson is one tap away
home.practice.subtext: Straight after each lesson, a short quiz makes you bring every word back from memory.
home.practice.type_body: Pick the right answer first, then write it yourself — including filling gaps in real sentences.
home.practice.type_title: Type it, don't just tap it
home.practice.xp_body: +1 XP for every correct answer, and a +5 bonus when you get the whole quiz right.
